To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the method using Dalitz plot analyses of D0 decays in the CP-tagged and untagged samples is a promising approach for φ3 measurement, which is capable of reaching the precision of the current model-dependent analysis, and which provides the measurement that is not biased by the model assumptions.

(1) the φ3 precision of 0.05π can be achieved in the model-independent analysis with currently available data, provided that the Dalitz plot model is used, and (2) the model-independent analysis of B± decays only is not sufficient, and the analysis involving the study of ψ(3770), which is a source of D0 pairs with opposite CP tags, is required to reach the desired precision.

(i) a model-independent measurement of φ3 can be achieved using the method of Dalitz plot analysis, (ii) a model-independent analysis using CP-tagged decays only is not possible with currently available data, (iii) the method of the simultaneous binned Dalitz plot analysis for B±→DK+ and ψ(377)→D0D0 decays allows to reach the model-independent φ3 precision comparable with the precision obtained from the unbinned model-dependent Dalitz plot

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of quantum-correlation in the Dalitz plot analysis allows us to obtain the φ3 value which is free from model assumptions.
, in the case of limited data sample, the use of quantum-correlation between D0 and D0 mesons is a crucial ingredient of φ3 extraction.
the method of Dalitz plot analysis is an efficient tool for the measurement of the CKM angle, and it is worth to continue the study of its application for the φ3 measurement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combined analysis of B± and ψ(4S) data provides the best way to measure the CKM angle using Dalitz analysis of D0 decays.
the model-independent φ3 measurement can be performed with the data collected by B factories, but only at the cost of the increased statistical uncertainty.
the model-independent φ3 measurement can be performed with the currently available data sample, provided the analysis of B± decays is supplemented with the study of ψ(3770).
